text:
mira: quick catch - Petra-Lite model card and the model_support CSV use different keys for the quantized profile (CSV: `quant_prof`, cards/snippets: `quantization_profile`). SDK integ tests are failing on CI.

jin: link to the PR?

mira: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1130 (added Petra-Lite). Test failure snippet: 
```
KeyError: 'quantization_profile' in examples[0]
Found keys: name,family,quant_prof,seq_limit
```

sara: we should standardize to `quantization_profile` across docs and CSV, and publish a short migration note. Keep the SDK tolerant for one release.

alex: SDK change is already smallsdk-js has a fallback for `quant_prof` and logs deprecation. I'll open a test PR to assert both keys are accepted for now.

natalie: I'll update the CSV and the model card snippets, and add a Limits clarification: the quantized Petra-Lite variants reduce KV cache so on small GPUs seq_limit ~4096 not 8k as previously stated. Adding a short paragraph and a bench command.

jin: include a migration example showing both keys so docs and SDK tests match. Also add a one-line changelog entry in models/CHANGELOG.md.

docs-bot: reminder: bump model card frontmatter version or the linter will fail.

natalie: draft Limits note: > Note: Petra-Lite quantized variants have a smaller KV cache; for small GPUs we recommend limiting sequences to 4096 when running quantized. For long-context use non-quantized or extended-KV variants. Link to Optimize/quantization guide.

mira: add quick bench snippet for reproducibility:
```
# quick perf check
python tools/bench.py --model petra-lite-quant --seq 4096 --batch 1
```

alex: opened SDK tests PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/338  fallback + deprecation test included. CI green.

natalie: pushed docs PR 1134 with CSV fix, card snippet updates, migration example, Limits note, canonical guide link, and changelog entry. Fixed a redirect on the guide link.

jin: running local integration tests with updated docs and SDK changes.

mira: link-checker initially flagged the guide anchor; Natalie fixed. Docs linter is green after frontmatter bump.

jin: once both PRs merge, we'll add a short line to this week's release highlights and notify customers who recently accessed Petra-Lite docs.

sara: thanks everyone 389
